# pcd_lb_loadbalancer (Data Source)

Look up an Octavia load balancer by ID or name. Exactly one load balancer must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pcd_lb_loadbalancer" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-lb"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `loadbalancer_id` (String) Look up by load balancer ID (takes precedence over name).
- `name` (String) Look up by (and report) the name.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The load balancer ID.
- `operating_status` (String) The operating status.
- `provisioning_status` (String) The provisioning status.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags applied to the load balancer.
- `vip_address` (String) The VIP address.
- `vip_port_id` (String) The VIP port ID.
- `vip_subnet_id` (String) The VIP subnet ID.
